items.name: SacCubing VIII 2019

venue.name: Placer County Fairgrounds
venue.address: 800 All America City Blvd, Roseville, CA 95678, USA

items.information:
![Image description](https://i.imgur.com/woQIbBl.jpg)

Sacramento's 8th cubing competition is coming up! Make sure to sign up to reserve your spot!

All competitors must be available to judge/run/scramble for the competition as per Regulation 1e2 and 1f2. All non-first time competitors will be expected to help by judging or running for any event they are doing. Nametags will be handed out with all the information regarding what groups you will be competing in and what groups you will be helping in. If you are not competing in an event, you will not be assigned to help during that event.

All donations are appreciated and will go towards things such as venue, supplies, etc.
